out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: THE CFM during the time of the inspection could not locate a copy of Vomit and Diarrhea poster in the establishment or a bodily fluids cleanup kit with written instructions.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. PIC was given a copy of the Vomity and Diarrhea cleanup poster during time of inspection.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at 73F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Water Pressure Meets Facility Demands
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HOT WATER AT THE THREE-VAT SINK TO BE TRICKLING OUT OF THE FAUCET.
violations.corrective_action: Water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures, equipment, and nonfood equipment that are required to use water.
